name: show_draw
description: Show a freshly drawn play on the coach's screen. Pass the draw_id that draw_play returned with status 'drawn'. Returns 'shown' when the drawing is on screen, 'not found' when the drawing has expired, 'not drawn: the call did not resolve to a play', 'superseded: a newer request is on screen' when a later show replaced this one (nothing went wrong), or a string starting 'error:' when the playbook could not be reached.

draw_id.description: The draw_id exactly as returned by draw_play.
